BREAKING: China’s crude oil imports dropped -41% YoY in June, to 29 million tons or 7 million barrels per day, the lowest in 10 years.

MoM, oil imports fell by -4 million tons, or -12%, to the weakest level in 8 years.

Import volumes have now declined -26 million tons, or -47%,
